thread:
jamie: quick heads-up — opened a draft PR to update the SDK snippets for streaming + pagination + retries across py/ts/go. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482. tagging reviewers: @carla (py), @ben (go), @leo (ts). main goals: unify examples, fix retry/backoff params, and show streaming pagination with resume tokens.
carla: ack, I'll skim the python snippets today. main thing: the current example still shows `max_attempts` which we replaced with `retry_policy.max_retries` in the new SDK.
jamie: yes — PR changes the arg name but leaves an old example in streaming.md. can you propose a one-line replacement?
carla: sure. suggested snippet (python):
```
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient()
for chunk in client.stream("gpt-open:base", prompt, retry_policy={"max_retries": 3, "backoff": "exponential"}):
    print(chunk.text)
```
carla: also added a short note about `resume_token` usage for pagination — see the draft comment in the PR.
ben: saw the PR. go snippet needs ctx cancellation and nil-checks. current example returns an empty token on EOF but we should show `ResumeToken` handling. quick suggestion (go):
```
stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { return err }
for {
    evt, err := stream.Recv()
    if err == io.EOF { break }
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Print(evt.Text)
}
if rt := stream.ResumeToken(); rt != "" {
    // store token for next page
}
```
ben: also, the retry backoff example was using time.Sleep loops — prefer the SDK `Backoff` helper. i'll add a small util snippet in my review.
leo: TS thinks the async iterator example is slightly off for the new `stream()` signature — it now returns AsyncIterable<TokenChunk>. change patch looks like:
```ts
const stream = client.stream({ model: "gpt-open:base", prompt })
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```
leo: also added typed interface in the example so editors show `chunk.text` correctly.
docs-bot: PR 1482 checks: lint ✅, snippet-tests ❌ (3 failures). logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/1482/snippet-tests. failing tests: python streaming resume test, go nil-resume check, ts backpressure example.
jamie: thanks bot. @carla @ben @leo can we triage the failing snippet-tests? i can run the failing ones locally if you want.
carla: i'll take python failing test. quick note: test expects `retry_policy` field to be dict not string — so adjust example accordingly. will push a tiny commit.
ben: i'll handle go and replace the manual sleep with `backoff.Retry(ctx, attemptFunc, backoff.Default)` and add the ResumeToken check. pushing in ~30m.
leo: taking ts failing case — it's about backpressure example not awaiting `for await`. will patch and sanity-run `yarn test:snippets`.
jamie: sweet. once we have green snippet-tests i'll merge. action items: carla -> py commit, ben -> go commit, leo -> ts commit. i'll re-run CI and land if green. :thumbsup:
carla: pushed fix: renamed arg, updated codeblock and added small explanation about why we prefer `retry_policy` over `max_attempts`.
ben: pushed go patch, added backoff helper and ResumeToken doc comment.
leo: pushed ts patch, fixed async iterator and added tiny note on `highWaterMark`/backpressure.
docs-bot: snippet-tests passing ✅ for PR 1482. all green. mergeable.
jamie: merged and backfilled CHANGES.md entry. thanks all. follow-up: file a small follow-up to add a one-liner in the SDK CHANGELOG about `retry_policy` rename so customers find it. created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/252
carla: noted, i'll add a cross-link to the migration guide in docs.
ben: nice and tidy. :tada:
leo: thanks — will glance tomorrow to ensure no broken anchors in the TS example. good job everyone.
